authoritative_origin.dataset_first_released_by: Mukherjee, Venkataraman, Liu, Glance, 'What Yelp Fake Review Filter Might Be Doing?', ICWSM 2013
authoritative_origin.graph_features_and_redistribution: Rayana & Akoglu, 'Collective Opinion Spam Detection: Bridging Review Networks and Metadata', KDD 2015 (SpEagle)

author_pages.https://shebuti.com/yelpchi-dataset/: HTTP/1.1 200 OK (reachable). States 67,395 reviews, 201 hotels+restaurants, 38,063 reviewers, 13.23% filtered reviews, 20.33% spammers. NO download link: 'To get the datasets with ground truth please email: srayana@cs.stonybrook.edu'
author_pages.https://odds.cs.stonybrook.edu/yelpchi-d: UNREACHABLE from this host. TLS handshake failure (alert 40) on port 443; plain HTTP 301-redirects to the failing HTTPS URL.

authoritative_origin.note: The authoritative release is email-gated. No author-hosted direct download URL was found.

actual_source_used.caveat: Not author-hosted. Contents were independently validated against the .mat-derived invariants (see verification block below) rather than trusted on faith.

files.description: Gzipped per-review metadata, 67,395 whitespace-separated rows. Schema: user_id prod_id rating label date (date = %Y-%m-%d). Decompresses byte-identical to metadata.txt.
Uncompressed form of metadata.gz. 67,395 rows, 5 fields each. Verified byte-identical to gunzip(metadata.gz).
HOTEL review text, one review per line, 5,854 lines. Corresponds positionally to metadata rows 0..5853 (product ids 0-71).

RESTAURANT review text, one review per line, 61,541 lines. Corresponds positionally to metadata rows 5854..67394 (product ids 72-200). Filename 'yelpResData' + 'NRYR' (Not-Recommended / Yelp-Recommended) is the Mukherjee et al. ICWSM'13 naming convention.
Names of the 32 handcrafted features (indices 0-31) in YelpChi.mat, keyed to Table 2 of Rayana & Akoglu KDD 2015. 0-14 review features, 15-23 user features, 24-31 product features.
Pickled dict {(user_id, prod_id): row_index}, exactly 45,954 entries, indices 0..45953. Keyset verified identical to the >800-pruned review set. Claimed row order for YelpChi.mat.

derived_files.description: DERIVED, not downloaded. 45,954 JSON lines, one per candidate graph node, in the canonical group-by-user order that reproduces rid_mapping.pkl exactly. Fields: node_idx, user_id, prod_id, rating, label, date, text.
derived_files.provenance: Built by pruning metadata to products with <=800 reviews and joining text positionally (metadata line i <-> concat(raw_text.txt, output_review_yelpResData_NRYRcleaned.txt)[i]).

derived_files.description: DERIVED. Per-node R-U-R degree, R-S-R degree and label under the canonical order. Intended for an exact row-by-row check against YelpChi.mat without needing this agent to open the .mat.

review_level_statistics.de_facto_review_key: (user_id, prod_id) - verified unique across all 67,395 rows, zero collisions
review_level_statistics.comparison_to_mat_node_count: RAW RELEASE IS 67,395, NOT 45,954. The 45,954 graph nodes are a strict SUBSET obtained by dropping the 19 products with >800 reviews.

verification_against_mat_invariants.method: Reconstructed the node set and relation graphs from raw metadata alone and compared to the CARE-GNN YelpChi.mat invariants supplied by the caller.

R_T_R_directed_entries.status: UNRESOLVED - roughly 35 alternative temporal definitions tested, none reproduce 1,147,232

verification_against_mat_invariants.row_order: Canonical order = group-by-user first-appearance order. Reproduces rid_mapping.pkl for all 45,954 of 45,954 rows. NOTE: this is NOT metadata file order (only 12/45,954 indices coincide).
outstanding_to_call_alignment_EXACT: Compare alignment_fingerprint.csv row-by-row against per-row degrees of net_rur / net_rsr in YelpChi.mat (not just totals).
Compare the label vector in canonical order against the .mat label array element-by-element.
Resolve the R-T-R definition so all three adjacencies reproduce.

version_notes.YelpChi_raw: 67,395 reviews, 201 businesses, 38,063 reviewers (shebuti.com, verified against downloaded metadata).
version_notes.YelpChi_graph_mat: 45,954 review nodes, 6,677 spam (14.53%), 39,277 benign - the >800-pruned subset used by CARE-GNN/DGL FraudYelpDataset.
version_notes.YelpNYC: 359,052 reviews, restaurants in New York City - DIFFERENT dataset, same authors.
version_notes.YelpZip: 608,598 reviews, 5,044 restaurants, 260,277 reviewers - DIFFERENT dataset, same authors.
version_notes.count_45941: UNKNOWN - no source found in this investigation attributing 45,941 to any YelpChi release.
